Options & Call-Convexity Playbook (AAPL)

NO OPTIONS EDGE — NO OPTIONS TRADE ($0 / 0 bps allocated): Underlying AAPL is REJECTED on VALUATION ($356.27 CMP vs. $330.00 Base Case).

Multi-Timeframe Chart Context (1W / 1D / 4H): Tight Stage 2 volatility contraction (Bollinger bandwidth 6.53%) above rising 50D SMA ($339.04) and 30W SMA ($317.60). Account / Chain Feed: No open Robinhood tab in Chrome; live account quotes skipped, using public options chain.

Why We Pass on Call Structures Here: While implied volatility (25.5% ATM IV vs. 26.8% HV20) is fairly priced, options cannot manufacture fundamental upside. A representative September 2027 $330 LEAPS Call (~$58.12 mid, 0.69 delta) requires AAPL to clear $388.12 (+8.94%) by expiration just to break even—and expires worthless ($0.00, -100% loss) at our $330.00 Base Case fair value. Consistent with our REJECTED (VALUATION) verdict and 0 bps equity risk budget, we allocate $0 to AAPL options and revisit convexity only on a valuation reset toward $295.00.
